description: Set the polynomial order of the interpolation basis functions. Linear basis functions are obtained for i =1. This leads to important cell-crossing error which can lead to instability under large deformation, but is faster and may be adequate for simulations with small to moderate deformations. Quadratic B-spline basis functions are obtained for i =2 (the default in MPoint). This reduces cell-crossing error and provides more stable results under large deformation. MPoint3D 9.8.54 accepts only 1 or 2 ('integer between 1 and 2').
